summary: Set the mail relay password in PIM Manager, and a new install run needs fewer database rights.

new.title: Mail relay password set in PIM Manager
new.text: A SuperAdmin sets the mail relay password under Settings > Mail & alerting. Nobody needs a Key Vault or database right for it: PIM Manager hands it over sealed, and the update stores it.

fixes.title: Fewer database rights during setup
fixes.text: Running the install again on an existing installation now also updates the database without making you a database administrator. Who is a SuperAdmin and which features are on are changed in Settings.
